human.headline: AI Voice Data Evaluator | English & Tagalog | Graphic & Logo Designer
human.bio: I evaluate AI voice conversations in English and Tagalog, checking responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, naturalness, and conversational flow. I provide objective ratings, annotations, and structured feedback based on project guidelines, identifying misunderstood speech and incorrect responses. My background also includes graphic design, logo creation, printing services, and customer support. I use Canva and Adobe Photoshop to create visual materials, prepare print-ready artwork, and revise designs based on client feedback. I bring attention to detail, analytical thinking, and experience translating customer requirements into clear designs and accurate order details.
